comingLast.roast: a high marker holding the blue balls - the honour board salutes the effort
11 points from 6 holes - entirely gettable, famously not got
escape requires 6 over the last 5 - his mates have started filming
current run rate 1.2 - the presentation script has him pencilled in
he can still pass Bradley - stranger things have happened, rarely to him
4 points from escape - Bradley has stopped watching his own card
Bradley is one good hole of his away from inheriting the lead nobody wants
still out there on 17 - the clubhouse is doing his maths for him
4 points buys freedom - Bradley is pricing it higher by the minute
needs 3 points from his last 5 to hand the blue balls to Bradley
